viewing_check: Ask to power it on: CD tray load, disc read, radio, display, speaker output. Look for the Type number on the back (2582 for BeoSound 1), missing remote, power cable, cracks or dents in the cabinet, and a torn or faded grille cloth. Photograph the back label.
